issue.title: Move CMSIS downloads to a separate script.

repository.name: tensorflow
repository.description: An Open Source Machine Learning Framework for Everyone

issue.body:
This is a first step towards adding back some of the CMSIS patching needed to fix the Arduino build (http://b/175435756).

Moving to a stand-alone download script is part of the cleanup described in http://b/143904317

Also, this change introduces a common location for helper functions and fixes #46020
